title: The head element and metadata
learningObjectives: Identify and assemble the parts of a complete HTML document

understand.concept: The head contains document metadata and resource references. Its title element supplies the browser-tab title.
understand.whyItMatters: A useful title helps identify tabs, bookmarks and search results.
understand.analogy: A package label describes the product but is not the product; metadata describes a page but is not its main content.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a memory aid; HTML should not be interpreted literally through it.

explain.narrative: The head contains document metadata and resource references. Its title element supplies the browser-tab title.

examples.explanation: The tab says Learning Notes; the page displays Welcome.
examples.expectedOutput: The tab says Learning Notes; the page displays Welcome.

practise.guidedTask: Add a descriptive title and UTF-8 charset inside head.
practise.independentTask: Create your own small page, open it in a browser and inspect the result.
hints: Check that each element is nested under the correct parent.
